brand.slogan: Your Health, Our Priority — Find the Right Doctor Near You.

home.intro: Describe where it hurts, answer a few questions, understand which specialist to see — then find a verified doctor near you.
home.step1Text: Select one or more areas on the body map.
home.step2Text: Intensity, duration, associated symptoms… The questions adapt to your answers.
home.step3Text: See possible explanations, the recommended specialty and doctors near you.
home.discoveryTitle: Find the right doctor, close to you
home.discoveryText: Search by specialty, city, language or distance. Only verified profiles are shown by default.

checker.whereTitle: Where do you feel pain or discomfort?
checker.whereIntro: Select one or more areas. You can switch between the front and back views.
checker.emergencyFirstTitle: In an emergency, do not use this tool
checker.emergencyFirstText: If you have severe chest pain, difficulty breathing, signs of a stroke or heavy bleeding, call your local emergency number now.
checker.selectAtLeastOne: Select at least one area to continue.
checker.questionsTitle: A few questions about your symptoms
checker.allAnsweredText: We can now show your medical orientation.

results.title: Your medical orientation
results.possibleConditionsNote: These are possibilities to discuss with a doctor, not a diagnosis.
results.noConditions: Your answers do not point to a specific explanation. A doctor can assess your situation.
results.worseText: Do not wait: contact a doctor or your local emergency number.

emergency.title: Seek emergency care now
emergency.noNumber: Call your local emergency number or go to the nearest emergency department.
emergency.unverifiedNumber: Emergency number for {{country}} not yet verified by docTHub — if in doubt, use the official local number.
emergency.notDiagnosis: This warning is based on the signs you reported. It is not a diagnosis.

disclaimer.title: Orientation, not diagnosis
disclaimer.orientation: docTHub helps you understand which type of doctor to see. It does not provide a diagnosis or a treatment and does not replace a consultation.
disclaimer.footer: docTHub is a medical orientation tool, not a medical device. It does not provide diagnoses. In an emergency, call your local emergency number.

doctors.title: Find a doctor
doctors.locationPrivacy: Your position is only used for this search and is not stored.
doctors.locationDenied: Location permission was refused. We use your selected city instead.
doctors.locationUnavailable: Location is not available on this device.
doctors.chooseLocation: Choose your country or city to see doctors near you
doctors.noResultsHint: Try another city, a wider radius or fewer filters.
doctors.noDistance: distances are shown only when you share your location

doctor.demoExplanation: This is fictional development data. It is not a real doctor and must not be used to seek care.
doctor.appointmentNote: Contact the practice directly to book an appointment.

favorites.empty: You have not saved any doctors yet.

auth.registerIntro: Only the information useful for your orientation is requested.
auth.consentTerms: I accept the terms of use.
auth.consentPrivacy: I have read the privacy policy.
auth.consentHealth: I agree that the symptoms I enter are processed to provide medical orientation.

profile.title: My profile
profile.sexHint: Only used when medically relevant to the questions.
profile.shareLocation: Allow docTHub to use my location for doctor search
profile.exportText: Download a copy of all the data docTHub stores about you.
profile.deleteText: Your personal data will be deleted. Anonymous statistics may be kept.
profile.deleteConfirm: This cannot be undone. Delete your account?

validation.password: At least 8 characters, with letters and numbers.
validation.pastDate: The date must be in the past.

errors.network: Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have access to this page.

admin.name: Name
admin.verifyRule: A real doctor can only be verified after at least one document has been approved.
admin.firstIsPrimary: the first selected is the primary specialty
admin.reviewNeededText: {{rules}} rules and {{guidelines}} guidelines are not approved. They are not used in production until a professional approves them.

summary.title: Summary of your case
summary.subtitle: Generated from your answers only. You can show it to your doctor.

followUp.title: After your consultation
followUp.intro: Tell us what the doctor concluded. It takes one minute and helps us check that our orientation is right.
followUp.consulted: Did you see a doctor about these symptoms?
followUp.wentToEmergency: Did you go to an emergency department?
followUp.helpfulness: How useful was docTHub? (1 = not at all, 5 = very)
followUp.thanks: Thank you, your answer has been recorded.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.subtitle: Quality of the orientation, measured against what doctors actually concluded.
analytics.diagnosisInConditions: Doctor's conclusion among the possibilities shown
analytics.followedEmergency: Alerts followed by an emergency visit
analytics.versionsHint: Only compare indicators between assessments made with the same rules.
analytics.privacy: Indicators are aggregates. The export contains no name, e-mail, phone, date of birth or internal identifier, and only patients whose health-data consent is active.
